_note: Night bandits (Tim OK'd 2026-10-17). Caps raised 1.5x for the 2x map 2026-10-19 (Tim). They walk in from the map's edge spots (district 'edges') at night, roam between its pois, and walk back out at dawn. Neutral until hit: then they and every bandit within joinRadius fight that clan until angrySeconds pass without being hit or nobody of it is within giveUpDistance. They die at 0 HP (no downing) and leave a body with ryo (+/- ryoSpread) on it: right-click it to loot (Tim 2026-10-19), anyone's clan can; unlooted bodies fade after lootSeconds. No heat. Stats live in units.json types. Seconds and world units; tune in playtests.
